notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Spirit.
description:
Cast Reins of the Vinesteed by paying {3}{G}, attaching it to a Spirit.
When Reins of the Vinesteed enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with Reins of the Vinesteed attached.
When the creature dies, Reins of the Vinesteed triggers, returning Reins of the Vinesteed from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to a Spirit.
When Reins of the Vinesteed enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step ?, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4.
